predictions.tradable_instrument_name: iPath Series B S&P 500 VIX Short-Term Futures ETN

time_plan.30m: Confirm the prob move is real (not thin-book noise) and check whether any credible resignation/health/legal headline is already circulating on wires.
time_plan.1h: Check VIX spot and VXX intraday; look for confirming move in SPY put skew and Treasury futures.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether move is sustained or mean-reverting; compare to any official White House statement.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether story became public (news confirmation) — if so signal already priced; if not, watch for continued vol bid.
time_plan.12h: Close research window: log realized VXX return vs prediction and whether an anomaly preceded public confirmation.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a Trump resignation would signal an unpriced US political-succession shock. Regardless of whether the ultimate policy path is bullish or bearish, sudden leadership uncertainty reliably spikes short-dated equity volatility as markets reprice tail risk. Volatility proxies are the cleanest, most directionally-robust expression because the equity-index direction itself is ambiguous.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify gold spot reaction and whether DXY is moving simultaneously (dollar-negative would amplify gold).
time_plan.1h: Check whether the prob move coincides with any concrete headline; distinguish haven bid from pure USD weakness.
time_plan.2h: Reassess magnitude; gold moves this large are rare intraday without confirmed news.
time_plan.6h: Determine if event became public; if priced, expect fade.
time_plan.12h: Log realized GLD return vs prediction and lead/lag vs public confirmation.

predictions.reasoning: A credible US presidential-succession shock is a classic safe-haven catalyst, drawing flows into gold as a political/geopolitical hedge. Effect is smaller and slower than the vol response and likely below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a supporting, lower-conviction mapping rather than a standalone signal.

evidence_used: Market question implies a rare, high-impact US political-succession event
Base rate of a sitting president resigning is extremely low
Political-instability shocks historically spike equity volatility and bid safe havens
12h window with a 700bps tradability threshold favors high-beta vol proxies over broad index
uncertainty_notes: Equity-index direction is genuinely ambiguous: some investors view Trump policy (tariffs, unpredictability) as a risk premium whose removal could be equity-positive
This market is a very noisy, low-liquidity sensor; small notional can swing implied probability without information
Absent an actual resignation, most of the modeled magnitude will not materialize

llm_justification.summary: The market tracks a rare, high-impact event: a US presidential resignation. A sharp jump in its implied probability would most likely reflect an unpriced political-succession shock. The most direction-robust public-market expression is a spike in US equity volatility (VXX/VIX), with a smaller safe-haven bid in gold. Broad equity-index direction is ambiguous because Trump policy is itself a two-sided risk premium, so I avoid a high-confidence SPY call. Confidence is modest given this is an extremely low-base-rate, noisy market.
key_assumptions: A sharp implied-probability move reflects genuine information rather than thin-book noise
A resignation shock would raise, not lower, short-term uncertainty and volatility
Vol and gold proxies have meaningful, liquid exposure to a US political shock
failure_modes: The probability move is noise/manipulation in a low-liquidity market and no asset move follows
The event is already public (news-confirmed) so the move is already priced and mean-reverts
Markets interpret a Trump exit as reducing tariff/policy uncertainty, making equities rally and volatility fall — inverting the thesis
Gold's move is dominated by unrelated USD/rates flows, making it a weak proxy
Realized magnitudes fall well below the 700bps threshold, leaving no tradable signal
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
